name: God Helmet: hippocampus both sides, then amygdala left (60 min)
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva God Helmet software); signal templates licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: Todd Murphy's two-phase Shiva God Helmet session: the hippocampal 'LTP' signal over both temporal lobes, then the amygdala burst-firing signal over the left temporal lobe only. The vendor states phase 2 aims at a sense of presence, elation, joy, inner imagery and love; 60-minute version.
notes: 60-minute version (30 + 30 min, switching abruptly); the vendor also offers a 40-minute version (murphy-gh-hippbi-amyl-40min). Four coils per temporal lobe in a cross centred near T7/T8 (an inference from 'four coils over each temporal lobe'); the field steps from coil to coil, 'clockwise over the left side, counter-clockwise over the right' as the vendor states, read with each side seen from its own side, so both sides step top, back, bottom, front (C5-TP7-T9-FT7 and C6-TP8-T10-FT8; an inference). An image caption on the vendor's session list says the signals cycle clockwise on the right side, which contradicts the text; this preset follows the text. The step time is unpublished (Murphy: one cycle takes 'a fraction of a second'), so 125 ms per coil (0.5 s per cycle) is used. The hippocampal 'LTP' file is proprietary; it is approximated by the project's Larson & Lynch theta-burst table (4 pulses at 100 Hz per burst) at the 5.4 Hz spectral peak the vendor reports for this signal, 4 bursts (0.6 s), then the vendor's standard 4-s silence; the burst count is a choice, and 0.5-ms points replace the vendor's 3-ms points because 100 Hz pulses need them. The amygdala 'burstx' file is proprietary; it is approximated by the built-in accelerating burst (6 to 30 Hz) with 230 points, the point count of the published lab burst-firing pattern (which used 4-ms points; Ryczko & Persinger 2002), on the vendor's standard 3-ms points, so 0.69 s, close to the 'about 0.7 s' bursts Persinger's lab reported at 1 µT (Persinger, Hoang & Baker-Price 2009); then the 4-s silence: about 9 s of field per minute (the vendor states 9.6 s). 1 µT follows Persinger's papers, which mostly report about 1 µT (10 mG); the vendor's own figures disagree (10-20 mG on one page, a 50 or 90 mG 'laboratory standard' on others). Murphy reports that fear or anxiety in phase 1 'can be a sign that the second phase will be especially effective', but anger or 'unreasonable restlessness' in phase 1 means stop; anger or a 'racing mind' in phase 2 means stop and never reuse this session (the vendor blames the left hippocampus 'spilling over' into the left amygdala). Not for people prone to anger. The vendor reports headache or pressure in about 2% with the hippocampal signal; if so, lower the intensity by one third. Vendor exclusions: epilepsy or seizure history, psychiatric conditions or medication, migraine, brain injury, drugs. Stop on any distress. Independent double-blind tests found no effect of the fields (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012).
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence (the vendor: 'silence, not just quiet'), blindfold or eyes closed; sit or lie relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. The vendor prefers night sessions on geomagnetically quiet days and a helper who can stop the session. No meditation, mind machines or drugs at the same time.
schedule: Vendor rules: God Helmet sessions at most weekly, up to 6, then a 21-day break; for 60-minute sessions the Shiva pages say weekly or every two weeks and the Shakti pages at most every 3 weeks (the longer gap is the cautious choice). Never on consecutive days; not mixed with Shiva or Shakti sessions in the same weeks; try a session 2-3 times before changing it.
